fields.label: What the cabin model does here
fields.value: no prediction: Pressure is not 1 atm. The model only works at 1 atm; its refusal says nothing about whether experiments exist

fields.value: BASS-II’s solid-material tests ran at 1 atm. FLEX’s tests were planned at 0.5 to 1.5 atm, which includes 8.2 psia (0.56 atm), but it burned liquid droplets, not solids. NASA Glenn’s 1g lab tests (Zayac 2024) do burn solids at 34% oxygen and 8.2 psi. Nothing ZERO-DRAFT indexed covers solids at this pressure in microgravity or lunar gravity, so it makes no prediction
